description: Replaces innovation record sections, reporting whether each was applied; a section built from an earlier get_innovation read discards any edits saved to it since that read, and text left as read keeps its comment threads and pending changes. In Markdown section text, rules and blockquotes are kept, LaTeX in $`…`$ inline or in a ```math fenced block is stored as an equation, \ce{…} inside those forms as a chemical formula, and \chemfig{…} or \smiles{…} inside them as a chemical structure. In a paragraph the write edits, a chemical structure left in place exactly as read usually keeps its stored forms, such as a molfile or CDXML. One whose \chemfig{…} or \smiles{…} changes, one moved elsewhere, and one in a write that reports incomplete mark preservation can keep only what is written.

invention_id.description: The invention disclosure: document:<id> as search returns it, or its invention_id

sections.description: Named invention sections and their full replacement text

details.description: Full replacement text for the Further details section; an empty string clears the section

priorArt.description: Full replacement text for the Prior art section; an empty string clears the section

problem.description: Full replacement text for the Problem section; an empty string clears the section

shortcomings.description: Full replacement text for the Prior art shortcomings section; an empty string clears the section

solution.description: Full replacement text for the Solution section; an empty string clears the section

name: update_innovation

detached_threads.description: Comment threads whose anchored text this write removed. They still exist but no longer point at any text; re-anchor or resolve them in the app.

quote.description: The text the thread was anchored on before this write

dropped.description: Markdown the write could not store. Empty when everything was kept.

kind.description: What was dropped: image, footnote, horizontalRule or unsupported

text.description: The markdown as written, shortened when long

marks_incomplete.description: The write was too large to match every edited paragraph to its stored one, so some were matched only roughly: their pending changes stay, but comment anchors on the edited text may have come off; those threads are listed as detached. Smaller writes keep them.
